label: MS-JK

semantics.notes: Master-slave JK flip-flop. Master is transparent when CLK=1 (level-sensitive), slave samples master output on CLK falling edge. Overall effect: data is captured on CLK rising edge and output changes on CLK falling edge. J=K=1 → toggle on next full clock cycle.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: HDL export approximates as negedge-triggered only. Master-slave two-phase clocking not modelled. Pulse-width sensitivity and ones-catching not exported. Synthesis-approximation warning comment added.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: VHDL export uses negedge approximation. Two-phase master-slave behavior not modelled in HDL.

testability.notes: Master-slave: output changes on falling clock edge (slave samples master). Toggle, hold, set, reset all apply at the next falling edge. Initial Q=0.

risks.description: HDL export loses master-slave behavior. Synthesized circuit has different pulse-width sensitivity than simulation model.

modelLimits: HDL export is a functional approximation only.
prevClk, qM hidden states not exposed to STT.
